text: Based on the tool output, the native forest on the property has experienced some loss. The observation tool detected a tree-cover loss event in 2025, covering an area of 13.5 hectares, which is about 3.91% of the total asset area. The JRC dataset corroborates that 98% of this event area was mapped as forest in 2020. Furthermore, the MGAP forest map indicates that 13.1 hectares of the lost area was native forest. Therefore, it can be concluded that there has been a loss of native forest on this property.
